text:
nora: opened PR #5342 to add a small migration guide for the observability Console metrics rename (legacy -> unit_cost naming) and to include a couple of tiny runbook snippets. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5342

ben: quick skim. Love the runbook idea. Two small asks: 1) add a sed example for quick single-file fixes, 2) mention panel `id` collisions on Grafana imports.

sylvie: adding sed example is good. Also please include a PromQL downsample example for cost/latency pairing and a note that sampling=false can cause under-attribution in trace-linked panels.

nora: drafting sed snippet: ```bash
# inline replace legacy metric name in exported dashboard JSON
sed -i.bak 's/console.cost_bucket/console_unit_cost_bucket/g' dashboards/*.json
# .bak files are backups
```

ben: solid. Suggest using `--posix` on BSD sed warning? Maybe show alternative: `perl -pi.bak -e "s/console.cost_bucket/console_unit_cost_bucket/g" dashboards/*.json` for mac users.

sylvie: and add jq example for nested targets since some dashboards have expressions buried in arrays: ```bash
for f in dashboards/*.json; do
  jq '(.panels[]?.targets[]?.expr) |= gsub("console.cost_bucket"; "console_unit_cost_bucket")' "$f" > tmp && mv tmp "$f"
done
```

ben: PromQL example suggestion for 1h rolling cost by service: ```promql
sum(increase(console_unit_cost_bucket[1h])) by (service)
``` and to compute per-request cost: divide by `sum(increase(request_count_total[1h])) by (service)` with a Grafana transform note.

nora: added PromQL and Grafana transform tip. Also included a short JSON panel snippet, but added a warning to null `id` before import.

sylvie: tracing-hook note: show robust normalization for Go and Node: Go `id := strings.TrimPrefix(trace.ID.String(), "0x")` Node `const id = trace.id?.replace(/^0x/, '') || null;` and explain why `0x` appears (runtime differences).

ben: nice. One more: QA asked to show a quick smoke test query to validate migration: `sum(rate(console_unit_cost_bucket[5m]))` should return non-empty data for expected services after import. Add that.

qa-bot: automated checklist: please include alt text for any uploaded screenshots and ensure assets path is under `/assets/images/docs/observability/`. Missing alt text detected.

assets-bot: uploaded 1 file to /assets/images/docs/observability/metric-rename-smoke.png

nora: added alt text and small border to the image. Also added the smoke test query and a short rollback note: keep backups and restore `.bak` files if import fails.

doc-bot: linkchecker: found 1 internal repo link pointing to path `assets/oldpath` (broken). Lint: code fence language suggestion for promql block. Spelling: 0 warnings.

ben: I'll fix the broken path and adjust fence languages. Pushed a tiny commit.

doc-bot: re-run checks... all green now. CI: pass.

sylvie: staging preview looks good, panels render, smoke test query returns expected values for our staging services.

nora: merging and backporting to main. Thank you all! :tada:
